Server-event rule (EXP-103-R2 lesson): if any action raises 'The server event processing returned an error', answer OK once, record it and stop blocked for an operator Designer reload; never try another route, retry, close or reopen after that error.

Designer gate (read-only except at most one reopen): User scope; FX_CustomerPortal open and clean (Save disabled), no dialog open; if it is not open, open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry (never Select Form OK). Record the Components tree (Pane (00) > flexlayoutPane_FX_CustomerPortal > Region00: header, Region01: main, Region02: footer) and where the header region lies on the canvas (the row above the first dotted divider, EXP-103-R3).

Place (T2): click the FlexLayout row in the Toolbox once, then click once inside the header region on the canvas (above the first dotted divider, away from the edges). Immediately record the Components tree: the new FlexLayout must be a child of Region00: header. If it was placed anywhere else, click the toolbar Undo once, record the state and stop blocked. Record the generated name and type from Properties. If the canvas click does not place a component, record it and stop; never use mouse dragging.

Name and class (T2): with the new FlexLayout selected, set Properties > Design > Name to FlexLayoutHeader (one plain fill, then Tab; at most one correction) and Appearance > Theme Class to FX_BlueBackground (open the list, choose it, then Tab; at most one correction). Record both values as displayed and whether the Properties header and the Components tree show the new name (reselect once if they lag). If FX_BlueBackground is not in the list, record the available classes and stop blocked before Save (Undo the placement once first). Then perform exactly one Designer Save and record its response and the Save state.

Default attributes (T2, read-only): with FlexLayoutHeader selected (reselect by its Components row if needed), open Edit FlexLayout Attributes once through its canvas control (hover first to confirm the tooltip 'Edit FlexLayout Attributes'; the nested FlexLayout's icons may sit at the top left of the header row), record Type, the region count and every region's ID, Length, Unit, Orientation, Alignment, Pack and Default Margin, and the Alignment and Pack options (open each list once; choose nothing). Change nothing; Cancel once; verify Save is still disabled.

Regions (T3): reselect FlexLayoutHeader, open the dialog once and make it have exactly two regions: if it has one region, add one with the Regions add (+) button once; if it already has two, use them; if it has more than two, record it and stop blocked with Cancel (deleting a region needs operator approval). Leave Type unchanged. Select each region row before editing it and set: index 0 ID header, Length 1, Unit Flex, Orientation Horizontal, Alignment Middle, Pack Start; index 1 ID user, Length 1, Unit Flex, Orientation Horizontal, Alignment Middle, Pack End, Default Margin 1,0,0,0. Some rows appear or disappear with Orientation and Unit (EXP-103-R3); set Orientation before Alignment and Pack. Record each value as displayed and the Regions grid before OK. At most one correction per field. If an option named here does not exist (for example Alignment has no Middle), record the available options and stop blocked with Cancel before OK. OK once (record any message), then exactly one Designer Save with its response and the Save state.

Readback (T4): close the clean FX_CustomerPortal once through its Form-tab control (answer No to any save prompt, record its text), reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry, select FlexLayoutHeader by its Components row and record Name, Type and Appearance > Theme Class, then open Edit FlexLayout Attributes read-only and record Type and both regions' ID, Length, Unit, Orientation, Alignment, Pack and Default Margin (screenshot each region selected). Also record the Components tree and that the root FlexLayout's regions are unchanged (header, main, footer). Leave the dialog with Cancel and the Form open and clean.

Capture screenshots of the gate, the Toolbox selection, the canvas and Components tree right after placement, Name and Theme Class after entry, the Save responses, the default attributes, each region after its entries, the Regions grid before OK, the OK response, and the readback. Use a distinct filename for every capture; never overwrite an earlier screenshot.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task (not from find output); after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references. Coordinates are allowed only for the canvas placement click and the nested FlexLayout's canvas icons when no reference exists; record each such click. Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. ExtJS comboboxes are not <select> elements (EXP-101): open their list and click the option. notes: Proposed by the operator assistant after EXP-103-R3; drafting requested by the operator 2026-10-16. Values from the transcript (05:20-06:31): a FlexLayout dropped into the header region, renamed 'flex layout header', theme class Blue Background; split into two regions: header 1 flex, orientation horizontal, align middle, pack start; user 1 flex, horizontal, middle, pack end, margin 1,0,0,0 (left, top, right, bottom). Factory mapping: component name FlexLayoutHeader (Form-local, tutorial spelling without spaces, no FX_ prefix); Theme Class FX_BlueBackground (EXP-100 FlexLayout class of FX_HelloWorld). Placement uses the verified recipe add-component-from-toolbox.md (Toolbox row click, then one canvas click), verified on Classic Forms only; dropping into a Flex region is new and the parent region is checked in the Components tree, with one Undo allowed for a misplacement. The tutorial does not narrate a Save here; the factory saves once after the placement (so no unsaved change crosses a task) and once after the region change. The Designer canvas may not render the theme class (EXP-065). Option names follow EXP-103-R2 (Unit Flex; Orientation Horizontal); Alignment and Pack option names for a Horizontal region are not yet observed, so T2 reads them before T3 sets Middle, Start and End. Server-event rule from EXP-103-R2. Regenerate is not authorized.
